html:
Greetings, Agents!
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The sorcerers of mystic arts have gained new powers!
​
In this additional patch, claim the new Uniforms for Mordo and Ancient One, 
Tier-3 advancement of Ancient One, 
and Baron Mordo, Kaecilius, and Clea who have become even stronger 
through Potential Awakening and Transcendence.
​
Check out the new looks and powers of the sorcerers by downloading the 5/10 Patch.
​
■ 5/10 Patch Details
​
Patch Schedule: 5/11 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 5/10 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 
* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be further noticed once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.
​​

[5/11 (Wed) 2:57 (UTC+0), 5/10 (Tue) 19:57 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 5/11 (Wed) 2:52 (UTC+0), 5/10 (Tue) 19:52 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


▣ Two New Uniforms
 
The original themed Uniform of the mentor of Doctor Strange, Ancient One, and a new 
<Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness> inspired Uniform of Mordo!  
Two new Uniforms will be added.
​
Check out the abilities of the two new Uniforms, Ancient One <Unleashed Mystic> 
and Mordo <Marvel Studios’ Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness>!  
 
* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 5/10 Patch data is applied 
and a 40% discount event will be applied to the new Uniforms.
* The new Uniform can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* The skills stats are based on the maximum skill level and Tier.
​ 

 


▣ Ancient One Tier-3
 
Ancient One is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Check out the mystic power of that Ancient One that has guarded our world since ancient times!
 

 


▣ Baron Mordo, Kaecilius, and Clea Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential
​
Baron Mordo, Kaecilius, and Clea are now available for Potential Awakening & Transcendence!
Check out the powerful chain magic the three sorcerers wield together!
​ 

 

 

 

 
▣ New Artifacts
​
New Artifacts have been added for Ancient One, Baron Mordo, Kaecilius, and Clea.
 
* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.
 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The issue of Co-op Play and World Boss Invasion related missions 
appearing at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive has been fixed.
 
2. The issue of the background color not being displayed at the content clear screen 
when accruing items with a rank has been fixed.
 
3. The issue of some UI being overlapped when chatting in certain circumstances has been fixed.
 
4. The issue of the Squad Battle related mission of the 7-Year Anniversary! Special Event Quest 

that will be held from 5/10 (Tue) 15:00 (UTC+0), 5/10 (Tue) 8:00 (PDT) 

being displayed wrongly as “participate” instead of “acquire daily reward” has been fixed.
* The event will be displayed wrongly as “participate” 
until the patch has been completed as the event will be held prior to the patch. 
Please make sure to acquire the daily reward to receive the event rewards.
 
We look forward to your active participation in the events 
held together with the new Uniforms of these two sorcerers.
​
Thank you.
